{{- /* Upstream footerBarSubtitle.pug — Typed.js / hitokoto into #footer-type-tips */ -}} {{- $bar := (.Site.Params.footer.footerBar | default dict) -}} {{- $sub := $bar.subTitle | default dict -}} {{- if $sub.enable | default false -}} {{- $effect := $sub.effect | default true -}} {{- $loop := $sub.loop | default true -}} {{- $source := int ($sub.source | default 1) -}} {{- $startDelay := $sub.startDelay | default 300 -}} {{- $typeSpeed := $sub.typeSpeed | default 150 -}} {{- $backSpeed := $sub.backSpeed | default 50 -}} {{- $strings := $sub.sub | default (slice) -}} {{- $typedJS := $sub.typed_js | default (.Site.Params.asset.typed | default "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/typed.js@2.0.12") -}} {{- end -}}
